decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to focus on standalone Bluetooth speakers, excluding accessories (cases, cables), replacement parts (batteries), and misleading listings (wired speakers or earbuds). From the remaining options, I selected a consideration set based on high review counts and star ratings, which indicate reliable social proof. The DOSS SoundBox Pro+ (008) and EDUPLINK (051) offer high wattage and great ratings at different price points. The ZEALOT (142) was included for its unique outdoor/utility features like the integrated torch, and the HyperGear (072) for its 30W output. I ultimately selected the INSMY Portable Speaker (128) because it offers an exceptional balance of price ($29.99), high durability (IPX7 waterproof and floating), and strong performance (20W) with a very high 4.6-star rating from over 6,500 customers.
